description: Search Glassdoor job listings by keyword and location, or scrape search, job, and company URLs. Filter by date, type, rating, salary, Easy Apply, company size, industry, and job function.

companySize.description: Filter by the employer's employee-count band.
companySize.title: Company size

country.description: Which Glassdoor country site to search.
country.title: Country

easyApplyOnly.description: Only return jobs you can apply to directly on Glassdoor.
easyApplyOnly.title: Easy Apply only

employmentType.description: Filter by the type of employment.
employmentType.title: Employment type

includeDetails.description: Fetch each job page for the full description, exact dates, benefits, requirements, coordinates, apply URL, and company profile. Slower and uses more requests.
includeDetails.title: Include full details

jobFunction.description: Narrow the search to one kind of role.
jobFunction.title: Job function

jobIds.description: Glassdoor job listing IDs to refresh directly, e.g. '1010224897915'. The country site decides the domain.
jobIds.title: Job IDs (mode=byUrl)

location.description: City, state, or country, e.g. 'New York, NY', 'London', 'Berlin'. Leave empty for the selected country's whole market.
location.title: Location

maxItems.description: Maximum number of job listings to return across all queries and slices.
maxItems.title: Maximum items

maxSalary.description: Only include jobs paying at most this much per year, in the country's currency. Leave empty for no maximum.
maxSalary.title: Maximum salary

maximizeCoverage.description: Run additional searches split by date, job type, rating, and salary to get past a single search's depth limit.
maximizeCoverage.title: Maximize coverage

minRating.description: Only include employers rated at least this well on Glassdoor.
minRating.title: Minimum company rating

minSalary.description: Only include jobs paying at least this much per year, in the country's currency. Leave empty for no minimum.
minSalary.title: Minimum salary

mode.description: Search by keyword and location, or scrape specific Glassdoor URLs and job IDs.
enumTitles: Scrape specific URLs or job IDs
mode.title: Mode

postedWithin.description: Only include jobs posted within this window.
postedWithin.title: Posted within

radius.description: How far around the location to search. Only used when a location is set.
radius.title: Search radius

remoteOnly.description: Only return remote jobs. Remote-only searches run market-wide because Glassdoor rejects city-scoped remote filters.
remoteOnly.title: Remote only

searchQueries.description: Job titles, skills, or company names to search for (mode=search). One search is run per query.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

seniority.description: Filter by the role's seniority level.
seniority.title: Seniority

sortBy.description: Order of the results. Sponsored listings may stay pinned at the top.
sortBy.title: Sort by

startUrls.description: Glassdoor search, job, or company jobs page URLs. Job URLs return one detailed record each.

url.description: Glassdoor search, job, or company jobs page URL.
url.title: URL

startUrls.title: Start URLs (mode=byUrl)

title: Glassdoor Jobs Scraper Input
